text:
maria (marketing): Quick sync 11 were targeting the Adaptive Routing announce for Apr. Need final changelog URL, canonical docs link, a one-line benchmark for the banner, and exact rollout window so marketing can schedule the blog + webinar.

alex (eng): changelog PR is open: https://git.internal/redwood/changelog/pulls/1033. Small opt-in API: `routing_policy`. Default unchanged.

nina (docs): Ill draft the docs. Please paste the minimal request example and migration note for pinned models.

alex (eng): Minimal example for docs:
```
POST /v1/infer
{
  "model": "rwd-adaptive-v1",
  "routing_policy": { "type": "latency_aware", "fallback": "rwd-standard" }
}
```
Migration note: customers who pin `rwd-standard` will keep previous routing; set `routing_policy` or remove the pin to opt in.

jasper (product): Messaging guidance: keep bench claims conservative. Marketing wants p95 delta and cost delta (with test context).

alex (eng): From internal run (10k reqs, seq=128): p95 125ms -> 104ms (~17%), est token cost -12%. Will add full test details to PR.

sam (ops): Proposed rollout: 2% canary us-west for 4h, then 25% global ramp if healthy. We can publish docs at canary start.

maria (marketing): Good. I need a 1-sentence press banner and a 2-sentence lead paragraph for the blog. Also want the docs live URL at canary start so landing page links don't 404.

alex (eng): Draft banner sentence: "Adaptive Routing reduces p95 inference latency by ~17% in typical web workloads and lowers per-token cost by ~12%."

nina (docs): Staging URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/adaptive-routing (will publish at canary start once PR merges). Ill embed the curl and the canary runbook in the page.

maria (marketing): Webinar planned for Apr 10, 10am PT. Speakers: jasper + alex + a customer. Slides: bench, migration, canary/rollback. Ill post draft copy by EOD Tue. Please add :eyes: when changelog/docs PRs are merged so I can lock the copy.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled job #deploy-176999 for 2026-04-09T20:00:00Z. Canary targets: us-west-2 2% for 4h.

sam (ops): Opening CRM webhook ticket to auto-tag webinar attendees / early access requests. OPS #543.

alex (eng): Will ping when changelog is merged.

maria (marketing): Thanks all  keep timing updates here so marketing can adjust publish windows. :calendar:
